title: Geneva Conventions of 12 August 1949 and Additional Protocols I & II of 8 June 1977

institutional_author.name: Diplomatic Conference on the Reaffirmation and Development of IHL (CDDH)

summary: Adoption of Protocol Additional I (specifically Part III, Section I — Methods and Means of Warfare, including Article 35 Basic Rules, Article 36 New Weapons Reviews, and Articles 48, 51, 57 on Distinction, Proportionality, and Precautions in Attack) and Protocol Additional II relating to Non-International Armed Conflicts.
